title: Autopilot Mode
script: Autopilot mode automatically retries failed renders. [Visual: autoretry]\nIt diagnoses errors and applies fixes. [Visual: diagnosis]\nThe render ledger learns from past successes. [Visual: learning]

title: Local Assets
script: Local assets use your own images and videos. [Visual: file folder]\nPlace files in input/visuals folder. [Visual: folder]\nThe pipeline binds them to scenes automatically. [Visual: auto bind]

title: Dry Run Preview
script: Dry run shows the plan without fetching assets. [Visual: preview]\nIt displays scenes, keywords, and settings. [Visual: plan]\nPerfect for validating before a long render. [Visual: check]

title: TikTok Platform
script: TikTok platform tailoring optimizes for the algorithm. [Visual: tiktok logo]\nIt picks the best aspect ratio and captions. [Visual: optimization]\nMaximize your reach on TikTok. [Visual: reach]
